## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new user-facing capability
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] refactor — behaviour-preserving restructure
- [ ] perf — performance improvement
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] test — tests only
- [ ] chore — tooling / repo hygiene
- [ ] ci — pipeline change

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name uses the agreed prefix (feat/, fix/, chore/, ...)
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] `npm run ci` passes locally (lint, typecheck, format:check, test, build)
- [ ] Added or updated tests where appropriate
- [ ] Updated documentation (README, in-code comments) where behaviour changed
- [ ] Added an entry to `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]` if user-visible
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or PII committed
